Codes anddemos

The lab’s public repositories on GitHub.

  • purkinje-learning

    Probabilistic learning of the Purkinje network from the 12-lead ECG.Jupyter Notebook. Open on GitHub

  • WarpPINN

    Computing cardiac strains from cine MRI with physics-informed neural networks.Jupyter Notebook. Open on GitHub

  • Delta-fibernet

    Learning fiber orientation in the atria from electroanatomical maps with physics-informed neural networks.Jupyter Notebook. Open on GitHub

  • reentry-eikonal

    Eikonal solver with re-excitability.Open on GitHub

  • logPSD-demo-FIMH

    A log-map-based solver of the complex eikonal equation to initiate re-entry in monodomain simulations (FIMH 2025).Jupyter Notebook. Open on GitHub

  • FKS-demo

    The fibrotic kernel signature, to estimate inducibility in atrial fibrillation simulations.Python. Open on GitHub
